newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Alliance details capitalisation shares.
newsitem.headline: Alliance details capitalisation shares.

text.p: Alliance Pharmaceuticals Ltd on Monday gave details of its "N" capitalisation shares which ordinary and "N" ordinary shareholders would be entitled.

Each shareholder would be entitled to the number of shares determined by applying their holdings on the last day to register, to the ratio of two cents multiplied by 1.05, divided by the average trading price of the "N" shares for the last four days ending at the close of business on August 7, 1997.
It said shareholders could decide to receive a cash dividend of two cents per share instead of the capitalisation award.
The new shares would be listed from the start of business on August 20, 1997.
